projects.name: FootballForge
projects.summary: A smarter home for football teams, player availability, rotations and matchday communication.
projects.problem: Coordinating players, attendance and matchday decisions takes too much manual work.
projects.solution: Bring the team workflow into one focused digital experience.
projects.pipelineNote: Live project · football team and matchday tools available.

showcase.audience: Youth football coaches, team managers and club volunteers
showcase.story: Team management becomes complicated long before kick-off. FootballForge combines player availability, team organization and matchday preparation in one focused workflow.
steps: Manage your teams
Keep player rosters, positions and relevant team information together.
Prepare matchday
Turn reported absences into a practical squad, formation and rotation plan.
Communicate clearly
Bring line-ups, match information and parent communications into one process.
views: Select a team and see its matchday workflow.
Plan players, roles and rotations in a football-first interface.
Spot absences and keep preparation organized.
showcase.privacy: The real app may contain information about youth players. Live pages are never embedded or automatically captured here.

projects.name: StudyForge
projects.summary: An interactive study space for practice tests, flashcards and visible learning progress.
projects.problem: Studying needs to feel clearer, more practical and more engaging.
projects.solution: Turn study material into focused exercises and progress tracking.
projects.pipelineNote: Live project · practice tests, flashcards and progress.

showcase.audience: Students and families who want practice that feels manageable
showcase.story: StudyForge turns practice into a simple routine: choose what to work on, test your knowledge, use flashcards and see your progress. The experience stays focused on learning rather than complicated administration.
steps: Choose your activity
Open practice tests or flashcards for a focused learning session.
Practice at your pace
Repeat exercises and revisit difficult material.
Watch your progress
Use results to see what needs another attempt.
views: A clear starting point for a study session.
showcase.privacy: Personal student dashboards and results are not embedded or captured on the public showcase.

projects.name: The Fascination Files
projects.summary: Cinematic stories and remarkable facts about science, technology, nature and the unexplained.
projects.problem: Amazing discoveries deserve a more memorable way of being shared.
projects.solution: Combine researched facts and cinematic visual storytelling.
projects.pipelineNote: Published creative project · explore on Instagram.

showcase.audience: Curious minds who love science, discovery and remarkable stories
showcase.story: The Fascination Files explores the surprising side of science, nature, history, technology and mystery through short, visually distinctive storytelling.
steps: Discover a subject
Explore a surprising fact or a question worth asking.
See the story
Cinematic visual treatments make each idea memorable.
Keep exploring
Follow the evolving library of facts and discoveries on Instagram.
views: A concept look at the storytelling style.
Themes spanning science, technology and wonder.
showcase.privacy: Illustrative visuals shown here are not captured Instagram posts.

projects.name: SAFe Agile Forge
projects.summary: A role-based PI Ceremony Planner and PI Event Command Center, with calendar and offline exports.
projects.problem: PI ceremonies and large planning events need a coherent overview of people, timing, readiness and outcomes.
projects.solution: Plan the PI in a browser-based workspace, without direct Defence or Microsoft 365 integration.
features: PI Event Planner and ART context
projects.pipelineNote: Working prototype · browser acceptance and independent hosting still to be verified.

showcase.lead: From PI chaos to a clear plan.
showcase.audience: Release Train Engineers, Product Managers, Product Owners and Scrum Masters
showcase.story: SAFe Agile Forge makes PI ceremonies and planning events easier to prepare. The browser-based prototype focuses on useful role guidance, iteration calendars, event planning and offline deliverables.
steps: Choose the role
Start from the ceremonies and responsibilities that matter for your role.
Plan the Program Increment
Work with iteration dates, ceremonies and PI Event preparation.
Export and share
Create calendar or offline planning artifacts as supported by the prototype.
views: A guided view of ceremony planning by responsibility.
A conceptual overview of exported sessions and preparation.
showcase.privacy: No direct Defence-system or Microsoft 365 integration. Do not use operationally sensitive information. The linked SAFe website is a beta; availability and organizational approval must be verified.

projects.name: WoW LifeForge
projects.tagline: Your character. Your journey. Your legend.
projects.summary: A World of Warcraft: Forever addon concept to chronicle adventures, friendships and milestones.
projects.problem: A character's most memorable moments and achievements disappear into chat logs and memories.
projects.solution: Explore a way to preserve the character's story in a meaningful addon experience.
projects.pipelineNote: Addon concept · no published CurseForge release yet.

showcase.audience: World of Warcraft players who want to remember the journey
showcase.story: WoW LifeForge is an exploratory addon concept about preserving meaningful character stories, milestones and memorable moments. It is not a finished addon or published download.
steps: Collect the idea
Define which moments of an adventure are worth remembering.
Prototype an addon
Explore platform-supported data and a respectful in-game interface.
Prepare a release
If built and approved, distribute the addon exclusively through CurseForge.
views: Imagined presentation for a personal adventure journal.
A possible concept for memorable achievements.
An early visual direction, not existing addon functionality.
showcase.privacy: Concept only. No verified addon screenshots, packages or CurseForge releases exist yet.

projects.name: Wild Rift Counter
projects.summary: A smart lane-counter assistant for League of Legends: Wild Rift drafts.
projects.problem: Choosing counters during champion selection requires fast, relevant lane matchup information.
projects.solution: A focused draft assistant that starts with the opponent's lane picks.
projects.pipelineNote: Draft assistant prototype · lane-counter development in progress.

showcase.lead: A smarter pick starts with a matchup.
showcase.audience: Wild Rift players who want quick lane-counter guidance during draft
showcase.story: Wild Rift Counter is a lane-first draft assistant prototype. It aims to make matchup information easier to use before selecting your champion, including duo-lane considerations for ADC and support.
steps: Choose your lane
Start with Baron, Jungle, Mid, ADC or Support.
Enter opponents
Select the lane opponent, or both opponents for duo lanes.
Compare options
Review counter suggestions and make your own choice.
views: A simple starting point for each draft position.
Consider both ADC and Support champions.
showcase.privacy: Prototype data can evolve with patches. No claim of official Riot Games endorsement.

projects.name: Spark Lab
projects.tagline: Every idea starts with a spark.
projects.summary: A browser-based idea workshop that generates a clear first brief and an AI-ready build prompt.
projects.problem: A good idea can be hard to turn into a practical starting plan.
projects.solution: Turn raw concepts into a structured project brief, starting steps and a reusable implementation prompt.
projects.pipelineNote: Browser-based beta on NOVYX · browser testing and refinement ongoing.

showcase.lead: Your next project starts with one spark.
showcase.audience: Makers, creators and people with ideas they want to develop
showcase.story: Spark Lab is a browser-based workshop that turns a raw idea into an initial project brief, practical next steps and an AI-ready prompt. The first beta works without a paid AI API.
steps: Describe your idea
Write a few sentences about what you want to make.
Add context
Optionally name the audience, problem and desired format.
Take the blueprint
Copy a build prompt or export the starter brief as JSON.
views: A focused form to capture the first spark.
A structured starting brief and next steps.
Copy an implementation-oriented prompt to continue.
showcase.privacy: Inputs stay in the browser until you choose to copy or download them. This is not AI inference.

ideas.name: Prompt Studio
ideas.summary: An idea to expand Spark Lab with prompt iteration, reusable templates and structured experimentation.

ideas.name: Open Tools & White Label
ideas.summary: Make selected Forge tools reusable without maintaining a separate custom version for everyone.

ideas.name: Forge Automations
ideas.summary: Explore small automations that connect useful ideas with everyday tasks.
